tagline: European advocacy and standardization organization for inland waterway transport
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR is an international non-profit association founded in 1877, representing the interests of the European inland waterway container and freight transport sector. Traditional financial KPIs do not apply; the key metric is the number of active members and geographic reach.

kpis.name: Member Count
kpis.explanation: Member organizations across European inland shipping sector
kpis.description: The 2024 report mentions more than 215 participants at the Frankfurt annual congress from 11 European countries, but the total number of members is not specified in the provided document.

kpis.name: Geographic Coverage (countries)
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in IVR membership and activities
kpis.description: The 2024 report indicates 11 countries represented at the Frankfurt congress (May 2024) and mentions participation from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany at the November 2024 colloquium.

kpis.name: Major events organized per year
kpis.explanation: Key annual events including Congress and specialized colloquia
kpis.description: 2024 saw the organization of the IVR annual congress (May 15-17 in Frankfurt with 225 participants) and the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium (November 4 in Antwerp with 80 participants).

kpis.name: Annual congress participation
kpis.explanation: Participants at the flagship annual IVR Congress
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR congress in Frankfurt hosted 225 participants from 11 different countries, held May 15-17, 2024.

kpis.name: Loss prevention colloquium participation
kpis.explanation: Participants at inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium
kpis.description: The inaugural IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium held on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp brought together approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany.

kpis.name: Technical publications and information sheets
kpis.explanation: Technical guidance documents published for industry standardization
kpis.description: In 2024, several new technical information sheets were published by IVR committees to provide the sector with current and relevant information, in line with CESNI standardization objectives.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 9.63 billion EUR in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 2.88 billion EUR in latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided 2024 annual report. IVR focus remains on regulatory compliance, inland waterway transport standards, loss prevention, and industry coordination.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or generative AI technologies
No digital transformation or automation initiatives mentioned beyond basic digitalization standards discussion via CESNI
Focus of the 2024 annual report on organizational activities, congresses, regulatory representation, and technical standardization for inland navigation
